resources.string: AlpenSync copies your people between this phone and Proton Mail. Like iCloud Contacts, without Apple or Google.
Add or change someone in Contacts. AlpenSync sends that to Proton.
Change a number in Proton Mail. AlpenSync brings it back here.
Get notified if this connection needs to be re-authed.
If Proton drops the session, AlpenSync will tell you so you can relink. Nothing else. The notice stays until you sign in again.
Proton ended this connection. Sign in again to sync.
Proton dropped or revoked this session. Contacts already on the phone stay put. Sign in again to relink and resume push and pull.
The stored session was missing key material and was wiped. Sign in again to relink.
Login failed. Wrong username or password (or the connection dropped mid-login).
Proton rejected our app-version token. The API moved, update needed.
Could not reach the Proton API. Check the network connection. (Also possible: Proton changed the API shape.)

Proton demands human verification (captcha) before this login can proceed. If you cancelled the in-app check, retry to see it again. Manual fallback: log in once with this account at proton.me in a browser to clear the challenge, then retry here.
This account uses a separate mailbox password (two-password mode). Not supported yet.
A security check on Proton\'s login parameters failed (modulus signature or server proof). Aborted fail-closed. Possible MITM or an API change.
Login succeeded but key setup failed. The session was wiped. Try again.
That two-factor code was rejected (or the 2FA call failed). Try again.
Internal state error. Please log in again.

Proton returned error %1$s. A response this app version has no typed handling for. The login was aborted safely; retry, and if it persists please report the code. Details are in the device log (tag AlpenSync).
Unexpected error (%1$s). AlpenSync contained it instead of crashing. Details are in the device log (tag AlpenSync).
Pull your contacts down to begin.
Edits on this phone go up on their own. They do not wait for the interval.
Changes on the web or another device come down on your schedule. Sync now pulls immediately.
Contacts stay on this phone, in the stock app
Needed so Contacts and the dialer can see your Proton book. Traffic goes only to Proton.
The sync account could not be created
Pulling contacts from Proton. The first sync can take several minutes on a large book.
Stay on this screen. The first pull is still running.
A large delete was stopped. Nothing on the phone changed.
Pull Proton contacts onto this phone
How often to look for changes made on Proton. Edits on this phone push on their own.
No logged-in session with key material. Log in first.
Proton demands human verification (Code 9001). Log in once with this account at proton.me in a browser, then retry.
Proton no longer accepts this app build. Relinking will not fix it. Update AlpenSync.
Keyring unlock failed. This session can\'t decrypt contacts. Log out and log in again.
Sync failed (network or contacts-provider IO). Check the connection and retry.
Sync hit an unexpected error. AlpenSync contained it instead of crashing. Details are in the device log (tag AlpenSync).
